name: HeLa USD
oneLiner: HLUSD is the HeLa ecosystem's centralized dollar stablecoin, backed by fiat and fiat-equivalent reserves and used as the HeLa runtime settlement asset.
collateral: Fiat and fiat-equivalent reserve assets supporting the HeLa ecosystem's HLUSD stablecoin at a one U.S. dollar target
pegMechanism: Issuer- and ecosystem-managed stablecoin used as the HeLa runtime settlement asset, with external pricing and market-cap coverage supplied by CoinGecko

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: HLUSD is managed by the HeLa ecosystem and its native chain is not yet modeled in Pharos contracts; available sources do not prove a direct holder blacklist path, so admin-control risk is retained as possible.

mintAuthority.summary: HLUSD is issued and managed by HeLa Labs (Singapore) as the HeLa ecosystem's centralized dollar settlement asset, minted against fiat and fiat-equivalent reserves through an issuer/ecosystem-controlled backend on HeLa's native chain.

controls.label: HeLa Labs issuance backend
controls.evidence: HeLa Labs / the HeLa ecosystem mints and manages HLUSD against fiat-equivalent reserves as the chain's settlement asset per its governance docs; supply is issuer-controlled with no permissionless or user-collateralized mint route.

review.evidence: HeLa documentation describes HLUSD as an issuer/ecosystem-managed stablecoin backed by fiat and fiat-equivalent reserves and used as the HeLa runtime settlement asset; minting is centralized at the issuer.
review.sourceFreeRationale: Classification based on the issuer/ecosystem model in HeLa documentation; the on-chain minter/admin could not be resolved because HLUSD's native HeLa chain is not modeled in Pharos contracts.
unresolvedQuestions: Resolve the HLUSD mint authority/admin on HeLa's native chain once that chain is modeled before raising confidence.

notices.title: Native chain not yet supported
notices.message: CoinGecko lists HLUSD without a supported Pharos contract platform. Runtime coverage uses the CoinGecko price and market-cap path while contract coverage remains intentionally absent.
